text:
Clara: quick sync — onboarding PegasusX (13B) weights landed in s3://redwood-models/pegasusx/13b/v1/weights.tar.gz. Please confirm sha256.
Simon: I pulled the tar, checksum matches. tokenizer.json has "eos_token": null though — that's odd.
Raj: that's a known variant quirk, some pegasus-style vocabs omit explicit eos. We should map it in model_card.
Ana: I can add a mapping in model config: `eos_token_id: 2` — but need to verify with vocab indices first.
Simon: FYI serving config I pushed to PR #421: `continuous_batching: {max_batch_time_ms: 8, max_tokens: 4096, max_batch_size: 64}` — need review, especially max_tokens.
Clara: tagging @Leo for scheduler policy — last week we saw prefetch thrash if `max_tokens` > 2048 on 16GB GPUs. :warning:
Leo: I'll run the dry-run with `max_tokens=2048` and `max_batch_time_ms=12` to reduce KV cache pressure. Will report perf.
Raj: tokenizer quirk: some sequences produce zero-length prefix because `bos_token` == `pad_token` in this vocab; enabled `force_bos` in runtime to avoid infinite loop. Need to sync with tokenizer override instead.
Simon: note to reviewers: cache eviction config in the PR is `policy: LRU, cache_slots: 256` — for chat workloads we might want 512 to reduce churning.
Ana: quick patch for model card I was thinking to add: 
```json
{"tokenizer_overrides": {"eos_token": "</s>", "eos_token_id": 2, "force_bos": true}}
```
Simon: thanks, that looks good. Also added a metric to the rollouts: `kv_cache_evictions_per_min` so we can catch thrash early.
Leo: running local warmup; current logs: p50=22ms, p95=78ms with `max_tokens=2048` and `batch_size=32`. Memory headroom ~1.2GB on node.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary -> dedicated-pool-3 at 2063457000 (trigger: PR #421)
Clara: OK let's hold the canary until PR fixes for tokenizer are merged and we validate eviction metrics from the dry-run.
Simon: I'll address the comments tonight and flip the tokenizer override to the model_card instead of runtime, then ping here.
Raj: rough checklist: weights checksum ✅, tokenizer overrides PR pending ✅, batching knobs adjusted to 2048/12 ✅ (pending perf), cache_slots decision (256->512?) pending, canary hold ✅.
Ana: added unit test for the tokenizer edgecase, currently failing on very long prefix case — will debug tomorrow.
Clara: thanks everyone — syncing async. If no objections, will unhold canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Simon: sounds good, I'll update the PR after tests pass.
